name: entra-mfa-report
description: Read-only capture of Entra ID conditional access policies and MFA registration via Microsoft Graph PowerShell read cmdlets. Requires Policy.Read.All and Reports.Read.All.

output_maps_to.when: conditionalAccessPolicies[*] where state=='enabled' AND grantControls.builtInControls includes 'mfa' — at least one such policy exists
